profile.headline: Anything is possible
profile.summary: I attained my B.S in Computer Science at UC Santa Cruz. I engage in good coding ethics, program efficiency, and work well in teams. My passion lies in helping others with technology, working collaboratively on complex problems, and continuously learning about emerging technologies. The adventure that is my career has led me to do exactly what I love; teach programming to young adults, create educational content on emerging p2p technologies, automate AP/AR solutions for companies, and currently, providing word-class support for our heavy construction customers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Maintain, optimize, and scale mission-critical desktop applications built on Visual DataFlex (VDF), C#, .NET SDK & ASP.NET Core
- Bridge legacy architectures with modern infrastructure by developing custom integrations, API hooks, and reporting tools
- Serve as the core technical subject matter expert (SME) on proprietary business rules embedded deep within legacy software stacks
- Lead the initiative to update and create new documentation for our onboarding and technical processes.

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.locationName: Sugar Land, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Delivered world-class technical support through various channels, building strong relationships with customers by empathizing with their issues and providing effective, timely solutions.
- Demonstrated expertise in HCSS products and proactively learned new software and technology trends, ensuring up-to-date knowledge to better assist customers and enhance support quality.
- Took initiative in identifying areas for improvement, creating and documenting new processes, and collaborating with internal departments to drive team success and exceed departmental standards.

positions.title: Information Technology Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with IT department to research a plan to automate redundant AP/AR tasks
- Developed and maintained script using Python, Selenium, Pandas, and Excel
- Reclaimed over $1 Million in invalid vendor deductions & saved 1000+ man-hours in backed-up claims
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Automation · Consulting · Information Technology · Parallel Programming

positions.title: IT Developer & Writer
positions.description:
Fierro Labs is my passion project to share my knowledge and expertise in web3 and general IT topics like: 
 system administration, decentralized storage systems, self-hosting home services, container management across multiple servers, and more.

- Created Fierro Labs Medium blog focusing on system administration guides and experience with self-hosting projects
- Created Fierro Labs YouTube channel; learned writing scripts, video and image editing, marketing, branding, engagement, camera professionalism, and more.
- Raised over $20K in grant money to R&D a brand new IPNS pinning service; self-taught REST API development, multi-threading, Q&A testing, and
positions.insights: Skills: Information Technology · Technical Writing · Go (Programming Language) · Blogging · IPFS

positions.title: Developer Relations - Technical Writer
positions.description:
- Produced technical content and video guides to onboard over 150 cohortees to technology originated with PL
- Meet with subject matter experts and deep dive into core technologies to maintain up-to-date and accurate documentation
- Lead small group sessions and interpersonally meet with cohortees to go over IPFS, IPLD, libp2p, & Filecoin
- Aggregate metrics in Excel to track cohortee progress to drive improvements to the program
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-team Collaboration · Technical Writing · Hugo · Technical Documentation · Video Production · Data Aggregation · Data Analysis

positions.title: Go-IPFS Contributor
positions.description:
- Two-week sprint, worked on a redirect library in Go that adheres to Netlify format
- Collaborated with team members to code and debug library for use in go-ipfs
- Work was later published into Kubo. Lead to a full-time position at Protocol Labs

positions.title: Medical Records Specialist
positions.description:
- Sort and make digitally available every patients' physical documents into their respective medical files
- Respond to and handle all personal and legally mandated record requests in accordance to HIPAA policy
- Juggle multiple responsibilities to meet department deadlines
- Cross-departamental collaboration for creating new procedures with the introduction of newer technologies

positions.title: Insight Decentralized Consensus Fellow
positions.description:
-Produced an IPFS tool that will enable developers/researchers to analyze decentralized data.
-This enables citizen science, to have anyone be able to contribute logs, but not give up the security to the database.
-Technologies used: Docker, Python, Go, bash, IPFS, and MongoDB.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description:
-Assessed customers technology needs and recommended solutions for them to purchase.
-Managed and onboarded 10 new employees.
-Exceeded departmental and individual quotas by 10%, month after month by engaging in cross department collaboration.

positions.title: Instrutor
positions.description:
-Create lesson plans and interactive group activities to educate 6-15 new students every week.
-Motivated new and experienced students of core computer science practices through fun programming challenges.
-90% and above, positive surveys from my students' parents, for customer service, knowledge, and professionalism with both parents and students.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description:
-Worked as general college math tutor for subjects ranging from pre-algebra to Calculus 3 and Linear Algebra.
-Helped teach up to 20 students in a 4-hour work day.
-Held position as Pre-Calculus TA, where I helped teach 30-40 students.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assist in logistical work of handing out music to volunteer musicians. Maintained an updated Microsoft Excel sheet of all known songs that the band has since it began in 2005 to current. Maintained an organized and structured library of music pieces. Worked closely with Music Director/ Conductor in matters of: being informed of upcoming event preparation, staying informed and relaying information to band members as a group and one on one, to prepare music a year in advance, music suggestions. As well as, was a Board Member for the Concert band which is a group of band members volunteers who plan and organize the events and concerts.
